descriptions.w3d_s4_card_reset: Resets card UI resources, releases both handle arrays, and clears card selection state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_add_record: Initializes and returns the next card record, then increments the record count.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_set_name: Passes a name and destination to the property setter with limits 255 and 5.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_check_boot: Starts the boot card check once and marks its flag.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_begin_load: Prepares card state and starts a card load with its loading flag set.
